eq-ch07-rk-stage: Stage $s$ forms the next stage state from the step-start state $\mathbf U^n$, the current stage state and the full-step increment $\Delta t\,\mathcal L$ with the integrator weights $w_0^{(s)}, w_1^{(s)}, w_2^{(s)}$.
eq-ch07-cfl-bounds: The explicit bound in direction $a$ is $\Delta x_a/(\lvert v_a\rvert+c_s)$; the implicit $x_1$ bound uses $\lvert v_1\rvert$ alone, scaled by $C_{\mathrm{adv}}/C$; a face whose velocity jump reaches $c_f$ adds the shear bound.
eq-ch07-cfl-dt: The step is the smallest of the bounds $\Delta t_a$, $\Delta t_1$, $\Delta t_{\mathrm{sh}}$ and $\Delta t_\nu$, each with its Courant factor, over every cell, block and rank, halved once per redo.
eq-ch07-redo-dt: Retry $n_{\mathrm{redo}}$ of a step uses $2^{-n_{\mathrm{redo}}}$ times the step of the first attempt.
eq-ch07-split-lie: One step is the dynamics over $\Delta t$, then the saturation adjustment, then the kinetics over $\Delta t$: a first-order Lie splitting.
eq-ch07-vic-size: The column system has $N = 3$ unknowns per cell when bit 3 of `implicit-scheme` is clear and $N = 5$ when it is set.
eq-ch07-vic-blocks: The three $N\times N$ blocks $\mathsf A_i, \mathsf B_i, \mathsf C_i$ of row $i$ are the Roe-linearised flux divergence, with the dissipation matrices $\mathsf A^{\pm}$ frozen at the faces and the flux Jacobians $\mathsf J_i$ at the cells, minus the gravity Jacobian $\Phi$ and plus $\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$ on the diagonal.
eq-ch07-vic-fold: In the partial system the tangential momenta follow the mass, $\delta m_{a,i}=v_{a,i}\,\delta\rho_i+\tilde m_{a,i}$: each block's density column gains its $m_a$ columns times the $v_a$ of the cell it multiplies, and the explicit remainders $\tilde m_a$ form the right-hand-side term $\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i$ that the sweep subtracts.
eq-ch07-vic-stage: Solving with the stage step $\Delta t_c = w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$ gives the stage-weighted implicit increment exactly.
eq-ch07-vic-sweep: Block elimination down the column and back substitution up it solve the block-tridiagonal system for $\boldsymbol\delta_i$, with the right-hand side $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv},i}/\Delta t_c$, the explicit increment in the solved variables (total density first).
eq-ch07-vic-pivot: A factorisation is refused when a pivot's ratio to the largest entry of its row is at most $\epsilon_{\mathrm{piv}} = 8N\epsilon_{\mathrm m}$.
eq-ch07-vic-faces: The face mass transfers telescope up the column from zero at the bottom face, so each cell gains the mass the solve adds beyond the explicit increment, less its share of the column residual $\Delta M_{\mathrm{col}}$.
eq-ch07-vic-closure: The mirror ghost increments are folded into the first and last diagonal blocks through the wall parity $\mathsf P_{\mathrm w}$, so the column system has no ghost unknowns.
eq-ch07-vic-steady-fixed: The VIC increment is zero exactly when the explicit increment is, for any invertible operator, so the explicit steady state is kept.
